description: SYN-15 answer-accuracy cases: real chat turns on the realistic personas (demo moment 10 October 2026). Expected figures were computed with SQL straight from the database, independent of the backend's analytics code (docs/synthetic-seed.md "SYN-15"). A case passes when the last reply has the expected type and tool, every 'facts' text is among the facts, every 'answer' text is in the answer and no 'absent' text is in the facts. MCP-17/18 add A11-A15 (budget and savings; independent SQL on 21 Oct 2026: Selin's August food is 0, Zeynep has TRY and USD). An 'answer' text is what the question asks for: A12 asks ‘aşar mıyım?’, so it requires the projected overrun; the spent amount is checked among the facts.
